title: Endpoint-direction vector consumer does not execute mutation expectation
description: python/tests/test_vectors.py fragmentation_endpoint_direction branch only asserts vector['expect_state_mutation'] is vector['expect_accept']; it never drives Link/SchcSessionManager state or observes whether wrong-direction input mutated replay/session/tombstone state. This is tautological and cannot catch the fail-before-mutation requirement. Make Python and Rust vector consumers submit authenticated direction cases through the production admission owner and snapshot/assert state/high-water/session capacity before/after, or remove the semantic field and place an equivalent independently parameterized production test tied to each vector.
